name: expandable-screen
title: Expandable Screen
description: A preview card with a photo, title and Tap to expand hint that morphs into a near full-screen panel with a bigger photo, heading, copy and a Get Started button. An X collapses it back to the card.
use: A preview tile should open into an immersive detail view with a smooth shared-element morph.
avoid: Keyboard users must open and exit easily: the preview is not focusable and the Escape hint is not implemented.
a11y: The clickable preview is a div with no button role or tab stop, and the promised Escape key is never implemented. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Collapsed, a rounded dark card holds a yellow-lit pug photo above a bold title, two grey lines and a small Tap to expand link. Expanded, a near full-screen dark panel centres the same photo much larger over a white heading, grey copy and a white pill button.
behaves: Clicking the card morphs its rounded frame out into the full panel while the small content fades away and the larger view fades in. The X in the corner collapses it back; the demo's copy also mentions Escape, but no key handler is wired.
customise: defaultExpanded, onExpandChange, layoutId, triggerRadius, contentRadius, animationDuration and lockScroll are root props; the card and panel content are children.
weight: light: A shared-layout motion transition between two small trees; no media loop.
demo: Pug photo; the card says Expand to Full Screen and the panel says Full Screen Experience with a Get Started button.
issues: The panel copy promises Escape collapses it, but no key handler is implemented.
The close X uses the foreground colour on a dark panel, so it nearly disappears.
polishWhy: Smooth shared-element morph; the invisible close X and the broken Escape hint are the flaws.
usage:
